explication: CodeFormer is a face-restoration application and BasicSR-based training framework. Its primary user workflow accepts an image or video, restores faces with a fidelity-controlled CodeFormer model, optionally enhances background or face resolution, and saves results; whole-image processing uses face detection, alignment, and compositing. Separate entry points provide face colorization and inpainting. The graph also covers training data, model/loss/metric layers, and documented video and demo support. Source excerpts show only parts of several paths, so unsampled capability links rely on README statements or are omitted.
